findings.title: No direct test of _flatten_training_config
findings.description: The YAML-to-flat key mapping (_YAML_TO_FLAT + _flatten_training_config) is only tested end-to-end through main(). TestConfigMerge tests merge_training_config with pre-flattened dicts. A typo in the mapping dict would not be caught.
findings.fix: Add a unit test that passes nested YAML config through _flatten_training_config and verifies all 11 flat keys are produced correctly.
